focus_area_title: Enhance a Sense of Belongingness in Your Team
content_text_body:
Belongingness represents the notion that each member of your team feels accepted, included and valued without judgement. The goal is to increase a sense of belongingness among your team in order for each employee to feel they are a valued member of the group.

Review the recommendations below and consider how they can be applied in your current work environment. Read this [article](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/blog/company-culture/2017/employees-share-what-gives-them-a-sense-of-belonging-at-work) for greater details on the recommendations. 

* Develop systems or habits to recognize the accomplishments of your employees (e.g. make public announcements communicating remarkable achievements, create a rewards system).  
* Acknowledge contributions during team meetings. 
* Cultivate authentic and open communication. Insist on participation and follow-up with team members who seem disengaged. 
* Make employees feel comfortable being themselves without a fear of rejection or judgement.   

To further increase a sense of belongingness, managers can also create opportunities for employees to connect and build what is known as "belonging moments." These moments include making introductions, showing appreciation for a team member, soliciting input in meetings to engage participants, and using storytelling to make connections and express feelings. Read this [article](https://hbr.org/2016/08/diversity-efforts-fall-short-unless-employees-feel-that-they-belong) to learn more on how to create "belonging moments."
